title: Full Stack Web Development
subtitle: Build modern web applications from the ground up.
description: A complete, project-led path from how the web works to deploying your own application. You will write semantic HTML, design responsive interfaces with modern CSS, program with JavaScript, build an API and ship a real product — understanding every layer along the way.

lessons.title: Welcome to the Course
lessons.description: Meet the course, the project you will build, and the rhythm of watching, building and reflecting that every lesson follows.
keyPoints: What you will be able to build by the end
How lessons, exercises and checkpoints fit together
The one habit that makes self-paced learning stick

lessons.title: How the Web Works
lessons.description: Follow a single request from your browser to a server and back. DNS, HTTP, status codes and what actually arrives on the page.
keyPoints: Clients, servers and the request–response cycle
DNS, IP addresses and ports in plain language
Reading HTTP requests in your browser’s network panel

lessons.title: Setting Up Your Environment
lessons.description: Install and configure the tools professionals use daily: an editor, a terminal, Node.js and Git — and learn why each one matters.
keyPoints: Visual Studio Code with a minimal, useful setup
Your first terminal commands without fear
Node.js, npm and version control with Git

lessons.title: HTML Fundamentals
lessons.description: Structure content with meaning. Semantic elements, document outline, forms and the accessibility you get for free when you choose the right tag.
keyPoints: Semantic elements and why they matter
Links, images, lists and tables done properly
Accessible forms with labels and validation

lessons.title: CSS Fundamentals
lessons.description: Selectors, the cascade, the box model and custom properties — the mental model that makes CSS predictable instead of mysterious.

lessons.title: Responsive Design
lessons.description: Design layouts that adapt from phones to wide desktops using Flexbox, Grid and fluid type — and test them like a professional.
keyPoints: Flexbox and CSS Grid for real layouts

lessons.title: JavaScript Basics
lessons.description: Variables, types, functions, arrays and objects — written the modern way, and explained through small programs rather than trivia.
keyPoints: Values, types and variables with let and const

lessons.title: DOM Manipulation
lessons.description: Bring pages to life. Query elements, respond to events and update the interface without reloading the page.

lessons.title: Async JavaScript
lessons.description: Promises, async/await and fetch. Load real data from an API, handle loading and error states, and keep the interface responsive.
keyPoints: Fetching data and handling failure gracefully

lessons.title: Application Architecture
lessons.description: How real applications are organised: front end, back end, data and the boundaries between them. Draw the system before you write it.

lessons.title: Building Your First Application
lessons.description: Put everything together. Build a full-stack task manager with a Node.js API, persistent data and a responsive front end.
keyPoints: Designing the API and data model
Connecting the front end to your API

lessons.title: Deployment
lessons.description: Ship it. Environment variables, builds, hosting and a deployment pipeline that turns every push into a live update.
keyPoints: Hosting a front end and an API

lessons.title: Planning Your Capstone
lessons.description: Choose a project you care about, scope it to something you can finish, and write the plan you will build against.

lessons.title: Building the API
lessons.description: Design and implement the back end for your capstone with authentication-ready routes, validation and tests.

lessons.title: Polishing the Interface
lessons.description: The details that make software feel finished: loading states, motion, accessibility and performance.

lessons.title: Launch & What’s Next
lessons.description: Launch your capstone, write about what you built, and plan the next step in your learning journey.

outcomes: Explain how browsers, servers and APIs talk to each other
Write semantic, accessible HTML and maintainable CSS
Build responsive layouts with Flexbox, Grid and fluid type
Design and build a REST API with Node.js
Deploy a full-stack application with continuous delivery
requirements: A computer running macOS, Windows or Linux
No prior programming experience — curiosity is enough
Around four hours a week to watch and build

reviews.author: Ananya K.
reviews.body: The first course that explained why, not just how. By the deployment lesson I had stopped copying and started designing my own solutions.

reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.body: Calm, precise and beautifully paced. The capstone gave me a real project to show in interviews.

reviews.author: Sofia R.
reviews.body: Async JavaScript finally clicked for me here. I would love even more exercises in the JavaScript section.
